title: DRVEXO-4B-Unified: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Speech-Vision System
abstract: arXiv:2611.25521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present DRVEXO-4B-Unified, a modular multimodal assistant built around a 4B language backbone. A self-contained checkpoint combines text, image, and speech inputs with reference-conditioned speech output and structured interaction. A temporal residual connector adapts acoustic sequences to the language interface; explicit text boundaries support incremental speech synthesis; and three task-conditioned scoring heads rank supplied action candidates alongside generative tool calls. These interfaces connect conversation to application-defined choices while leaving action authorization to the application. The system obtains 74.22% on all 900 MMMU validation questions, exceeding the published validation scores of Gemma 3 4B IT and InternVL3.5-4B without test-time scaling. Strict prompt-level IFEval accuracy is 82.26% and MATH-500 accuracy is 89.40%, above the original Qwen3-4B non-thinking report's 81.2% and 84.8%, respectively. On NVIDIA G

translated_title: DRVEXO-4B-Unified：模块化语音-视觉系统的设计与评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DRVEXO-4B-Unified，一个围绕40亿（4B）参数语言骨干构建的模块化多模态助手。该系统以一个自包含的检查点将文本、图像和语音输入与基于参考条件的语音输出及结构化交互相结合。其中，时序残差连接器将声学序列适配到语言接口；显式文本边界支持增量式语音合成；三个任务条件化的评分头可在生成式工具调用的同时对所提供的动作候选进行排序。这些接口将对话与应用定义的选择相连接，同时将动作的最终授权留给应用程序。该系统在MMMU全部900个验证问题上取得74.22%的成绩，在未使用测试时扩展的情况下超过了Gemma 3 4B IT和InternVL3.5-4B已公布的验证分数。严格提示级IFEval准确率为82.26%，MATH-500准确率为89.40%，分别高于原始Qwen3-4B非思考模式报告的81.2%和84.8%。在NVIDIA G……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于4B语言骨干的模块化多模态助手DRVEXO-4B-Unified，通过时序残差连接器、显式文本边界和任务条件化评分头将语音、视觉与文本交互统一到一个自包含检查点中，并在MMMU、IFEval和MATH-500基准上超越同规模的Gemma 3 4B IT、InternVL3.5-4B与Qwen3-4B等模型。
en_tdlr: DRVEXO-4B-Unified is a modular multimodal assistant built on a 4B language backbone that unifies speech, vision, and text interaction within a self-contained checkpoint through a temporal residual connector, explicit text boundaries, and task-conditioned scoring heads, outperforming same-scale models such as Gemma 3 4B IT, InternVL3.5-4B, and Qwen3-4B on MMMU, IFEval, and MATH-500 benchmarks.
